title: THE CRAFT PANEL SHOWS WHAT ITEMS DO
why: Seen on the 4K craft screenshot of 2026-10-08: since v19.23 the BUY panel shows what a Bandage, Medkit, plate, stim or frag does in numbers, but the CRAFT panel for the same items showed one sentence over an empty panel. It shows the same numbers now.
now: Crafting shows what the Medkit, plate, frag and the rest do in numbers.
